item.title: Argentina fires ravage pristine Patagonia forests, fueling criticism of Milei’s austerity
item.description: LOS ALERCES NATIONAL PARK, Argentina — These days, the majestic, forested slopes of Argentina’s Patagonia look like a war zone.

item.title: Trump’s $45 billion expansion of immigrant detention sites faces pushback from communities
item.description: With tensions high over federal immigration enforcement, some state and local officials are pushing back against attempts by President Donald Trump’s administration to house thousands of detained immigrants in their communities in converted warehouses, privately run facilities and county jails.

item.title: Musk Inc.? Billionaire combines his rocket and AI businesses before an expected IPO this year
item.description: NEW YORK — Elon Musk is joining his space exploration and artificial intelligence ventures into a single company before what's expected to be a massive initial public offering for the business later this year.

item.title: Federal agents must limit tear gas for now at protests outside Portland ICE building, judge says
item.description: PORTLAND — A judge in Oregon on Tuesday temporarily restricted federal officers from using tear gas at protests at the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement building in Portland, just days after agents launched gas at a crowd of demonstrators including young children that local officials described as peaceful.

item.title: 7 dogs competing for Westminster’s show big prize Tuesday night
item.description: NEW YORK — After two days, 2,500 dogs and more than 200 breeds, the Westminster Kennel Club is coming down to just seven canines vying for U.S. show dogs' most coveted prize.

item.title: Top Republicans throw cold water on ‘nationalizing’ elections
item.description: WASHINGTON — As many Republicans in Congress push for action on a voter ID bill, its future remains uncertain — and key voices in the GOP say they are wary of increasing federal involvement in elections.

item.title: Disney parks chief Josh D’Amaro will take over for Bob Iger as CEO
item.description: Disney has named its parks chief Josh D’Amaro to succeed Bob Iger as the entertainment giant's top executive.

item.title: Clark County sees six more cases of measles, bringing total to seven
item.description: Six additional cases of measles have been confirmed in Clark County, Public Health officials said Tuesday.

item.description: Leighton Livengood and Isaiah Barajas had 16 points as Fort Vancouver used a big third quarter rally past King’s Way Christian 81-70 in a 1A Trico League boys basketball game at King’s Way.
